headline: Wardens Regain Nevish Line Lead as Marban Hollow Flares
war_summary: The map has turned again on the Nevish Line, where the Wardens now hold six of eight strategic posts — a reversal of the Colonial lead reported last edition — after forty-seven base actions in a day, with Grief Mother and Princefal the busiest points and the firing continuing into the evening. Marban Hollow is the freshest storm center: five events in the final two hours, the last logged at press time, with casualty rates on both sides climbing past four hundred an hour. Kuura Strand, which blazed across the previous dispatch, has since fallen quiet, though its day's bill stands at 1,299 Colonial and 1,070 Warden casualties and all six posts remain Warden-held. The Weathered Expanse grinds on with twenty-one actions and Warden losses running half again heavier than Colonial; Stlican Shelf and Palantine Berm stayed active into the evening. Callahan's Passage recorded no base events in six hours despite rates near five hundred casualties an hour, and Mooring County and Viper Pit likewise stilled, though Mooring's casualty toll still mounts. It is day 482; thirty-four victory towns decide the war, and no victor is named.
